authority_rule: Planning sequence only. Live selection and implementation authority come exclusively from operations/CURRENT.json and its referenced MVPS checkpoint.

MVPS-01.title: Canonical Species Aggregate and Invariants
MVPS-01.goal: Define SpeciesDefinition, CharacterSpeciesSelection, identity/version/provenance, authored-vs-granted boundaries, lifecycle states, extension policy and executable-vs-descriptive separation.
acceptance: schema/contract fixture exists
invariants are machine-testable
no species-specific runtime engine is introduced

MVPS-02.title: Choice Schema and Character-Creation Transaction
MVPS-02.goal: Define fixed grants, selectable groups, budgets/counts, alternatives, substitutions, exclusions, campaign gates, unresolved choices and creation-stage validation.
acceptance: builder can enumerate required choices
illegal combinations return sourced validation
draft can remain incomplete without being playable

MVPS-03.title: Morphology and Body-Plan Contract
MVPS-03.goal: Normalize size-independent anatomy, limbs/manipulators, worn regions, attachment points, natural appendages and unusual body plans.
acceptance: humanoid and non-humanoid fixtures use one morphology interface
inventory/equipment can query body compatibility without species-name branching

MVPS-04.title: Scale, Movement and Sense Capability Integration
MVPS-04.goal: Connect scale profiles, locomotion modes and senses to shared capability/rules profiles.
acceptance: movement and senses are typed grants
derived values reference shared rules profiles
no duplicate movement/sense engine

MVPS-05.title: Physiology, Lifecycle and Environmental Tolerance
MVPS-05.goal: Separate descriptive biology from executable respiration, sustenance, rest, aging/lifecycle, temperature/pressure/gravity/radiation/water/vacuum and other tolerance hooks.
acceptance: descriptive fields cannot silently mutate mechanics
environment resolution consumes typed tolerances/adaptations

MVPS-06.title: Capability Grants and Natural Equipment
MVPS-06.goal: Normalize species-granted abilities, actions/reactions, resources, resistances/immunities, proficiencies, natural weapons/armor/organs and other typed capabilities.
acceptance: every executable grant has canonical identity and provenance
natural equipment resolves through shared item/ability/effect contracts

MVPS-07.title: Equipment, Vehicle and Interface Compatibility
MVPS-07.goal: Define compatibility predicates for clothing, armor, weapons, tools, implants, seats, mounts, vehicles, suits and body slots.
acceptance: compatibility is not inferred only from size
incompatible equipment yields explicit reason
common interface handles diverse body plans

MVPS-08.title: Lineage/Subspecies Inheritance and Composition
MVPS-08.goal: Define deterministic parent/lineage deltas, overrides, exclusions, grant stacking and composition order.
acceptance: lineages do not copy full parent records
composition is deterministic and replayable
conflicts are surfaced rather than guessed

MVPS-09.title: Forms and Transformation Semantics
MVPS-09.goal: Separate species from form and define changes/retention across anatomy, scale, movement, senses, equipment, attributes, grants, resources and presentation.
acceptance: transformations preserve base selection history
equipment behavior is explicit
reversal is provenance-safe

MVPS-10.title: Species Progression and Maturation Hooks
MVPS-10.goal: Permit optional species progression, maturation and unlock trees through the existing progression-event model.
acceptance: species progression is optional
all advancement is event-sourced
duplicate grants follow shared rules

MVPS-11.title: Social, Language and Knowledge Identity Hooks
MVPS-11.goal: Connect species identity to reputation/relationship/law/faction/knowledge systems without encoding culture or behavioral stereotypes as biology.
acceptance: culture remains separable
biological communication and learned languages are distinct
observer knowledge can hide canonical identity

MVPS-12.title: Validation, Migration and Import/Export
MVPS-12.goal: Define structural/behavioral/integration validators, playable/incomplete/invalid/migration-required states, version migration and historical-choice preservation.
acceptance: missing canon is never silently fabricated
historical selections survive deprecation
migration emits receipts/discrepancies

MVPS-13.title: Runtime Projection and Grant Receipts
MVPS-13.goal: Produce a deterministic current species contribution from base species + lineage + form + adaptations + campaign adjudications.
acceptance: projection is reproducible
temporary state does not corrupt base selection
each active contribution is source-traceable

MVPS-14.title: Authoring, Search, Inspection and Presentation
MVPS-14.goal: Implement species authoring/reference surfaces, builder projection, GM inspector, cross-links, assets and permission-aware presentation.
acceptance: UI is projection not rules authority
provenance and validation are inspectable
presentation data remains mechanically separate

MVPS-15.title: NPC/Creature Reuse and Cross-System Adapters
MVPS-15.goal: Prove player species can be consumed by NPC/creature/campaign/combat/social/exploration/crafting systems without collapsing species, creature definition, archetype and instance.
acceptance: no duplicate player/NPC species canon
shared entity references are preserved
cross-system adapters pass integration tests

MVPS-16.title: Radical-Species Conformance and Golden Proof
MVPS-16.goal: Run the common contract against eight radically different species fixtures and close all remaining semantic gaps.
acceptance: all eight fixtures pass the common conformance matrix
no species-name conditional is needed for core workflows
creation/runtime/equipment/environment/progression/transform/serialization/migration/presentation proof is recorded

MVPS-17.title: Core-26 Canon Lock and Production Baseline
MVPS-17.goal: Make Core 26 mandatory current canon and define one equal game-ready standard plus per-species baseline.
acceptance: CURRENT-referenced species-domain authority identifies exactly the Core 26 as current canon
startup/operating rules require domain consumers to load CURRENT-referenced domain authority before current species work
repository health validates Core-26 authority and rejects current-authority regression to 25 or legacy Nekron identity
one Core-26 game-ready standard defines the same certification dimensions for all 26 species
a 26-row baseline records existing evidence and gaps without treating historical 25-profile evidence as current certification
sealed historical 25-species evidence remains immutable

MVPS-18.title: Core-26 Canonical Object Reconciliation
MVPS-18.goal: Materialize/reconcile current-authority SpeciesDefinition records for all 26, including Morganthyr migration, Rog/Suula base objects and Akwi canonical-catalog convergence without duplicating its governed integration.
acceptance: 26/26 current canonical species identities resolve to exact-version SpeciesDefinition authority
no current catalog exposes Nekron as canonical
Akwi resolves as a core peer without duplicate mechanics
Rog and Suula receive source-backed canonical objects
historical aliases/migrations remain replayable

MVPS-19.title: Core-26 Mechanics, Morphology and Environment Completion
MVPS-19.goal: Bring every Core-26 species to the same MVPS mechanical/biological baseline for morphology, movement/senses, physiology/environment, capabilities/natural equipment and interface compatibility.
acceptance: 26/26 meet the same required mechanical/biological contract dimensions
missing source remains explicit rather than fabricated
nonhumanoid and unusual body plans use shared interfaces

MVPS-20.title: Core-26 Lineage, Form, Progression and Social Completion
MVPS-20.goal: Complete source-backed lineage/form/adaptation/progression and language/social/knowledge identity surfaces consistently for all 26.
acceptance: 26/26 have explicit applicable/not-applicable status for each optional dimension
Ratman subordinate lineages are governed without becoming peer core species
culture and learned language remain separate from biology

MVPS-21.title: Core-26 Current Appearance and Presentation Regeneration
MVPS-21.goal: Regenerate current-authority species picker, appearance, authoring/search/inspection and presentation outputs for the Core 26 using Morganthyr and Akwi current canon.
acceptance: all 26 appear in current-authority presentation outputs
historical 25-profile artifacts remain sealed
no current UI/catalog hard-codes 25
presentation/assets remain mechanically separate

MVPS-22.title: Core-26 Balance, Validation and Cross-System Certification
MVPS-22.goal: Validate/balance the real Core 26 across creation, runtime, equipment, environment, serialization/migration, presentation and NPC/Creature/cross-system reuse.
acceptance: 26/26 have validation and testing evidence
balance/adjudication status is explicit
cross-system adapters pass with real species records
no unresolved mandatory game-ready dimension remains

MVPS-23.title: Core-26 Game-Ready Golden Proof
MVPS-23.goal: Run all 26 real core species through the same game-ready certification matrix and close the production extension only when every species reaches the same required standard.
acceptance: 26/26 pass the common certification matrix
zero current-canon roster drift
zero species-name application branches
all required real-species content is source-traceable and game-ready
